assertions.name: no witness prose quotes a number absent from its data

description: Witness descriptions quoting a number the witness's own data does not contain. No staleness mechanism here reads a description -- they all compare a witness to its PRODUCER -- so a description that hardcodes a finding keeps asserting it after the data moves, and the file contradicts itself while staying green. Measured: rho-binding-constancy said '~182% (D 5.73, T 81.5, He3 37.4)' while carrying 3.87/36.99/19.12, matching neither the committed nor the regenerated data. Buckets by DISTANCE, not presence, so a 4% three-sig-fig rounding is not flagged like a 49% contradiction. FAR is a candidate, not a verdict: prose may cite an external constant. Bean qou-n62l.
